seo.title: Your Company — optician in Tashkent: eye tests and glasses
seo.description: A 20-minute computerised eye test, 400 frames in store and lenses made in 1–3 days. 9 Shahrisabz St, Tashkent.
seo.answer: Your Company is an optician at 9 Shahrisabz St, Tashkent. An eye test costs 80,000 UZS and is free with any order of glasses; frames start at 290,000 UZS, complete glasses with lenses at 550,000 UZS, made in 1–3 days. Open Mon–Sat 9:00–20:00, Sun 10:00–17:00.

listing.description: A site for an optician or eye clinic. A frame try-on with eyes that follow the cursor, a catalogue of frame silhouettes, an eye test laid out as chart lines and a prescription card instead of plain numbers.

sections.title: See clearly and still look like you
sections.eyebrow: Optician on Shahrisabz St · open every day
sections.subtitle: We test your eyes in 20 minutes, help you choose from 400 frames and make your glasses in 1–3 days. If the lenses don’t suit you, we remake them for free.

sections.label: About
sections.title: Eyes first, then the frame
sections.text: We start with the test, not the display: an optometrist checks acuity, refraction and how your eyes work together. Then we match the frame to your face and bridge width, and the lenses to how long you spend at a screen and whether you drive. Every pair is checked on a lensmeter before you take it home.

sections.label: Catalogue
sections.title: Frames, lenses and the rest
sections.intro: Prices are for finished items. We’ll quote the exact price of glasses with lenses after your eye test.

items.title: Round frames
items.text: Acetate and fine metal, for narrow and square faces.

items.title: Square frames
items.text: Office classics that hold their shape and don’t pinch the temples.

items.title: Cat-eye frames
items.text: Lifted corners in tortoiseshell and clear acetate.

items.title: Aviator sunglasses
items.text: UV400 and polarised, also available with prescription lenses.

items.title: Screen lenses
items.text: Blue-light filter and anti-glare coating for computer work.

items.title: Contact lenses
items.text: Daily and monthly. We fit your first pair and show you how to put them in.

items.title: A short chat
items.text: Where and how you use your eyes: screens, driving, books, sport.

items.title: Autorefraction
items.text: A machine measures how each eye bends light in about a minute.

items.title: Chart and trial lenses
items.text: We fine-tune the prescription until letters are sharp without effort.

items.title: Binocular vision
items.text: We check how your eyes work together, which affects eye strain.

items.title: Your prescription
items.text: We explain the result in plain words and hand you the prescription.

items.q: Do I need to book an eye test?
items.a: Booking means no waiting; the test takes 20 minutes. If an optometrist is free, we’ll see you without one.
Simple lenses take a day, coated lenses 2–3 days, progressives up to 7 days.

items.q: Can I bring my own frame?
items.a: Yes, we’ll fit new lenses into your frame if it’s intact and the right size.

items.q: What if the lenses don’t suit me?
items.a: If anything bothers you within 14 days, we recheck your eyes and remake the lenses free of charge.
Yes, from age 5. For younger children, or if you suspect a squint, we recommend starting with an ophthalmologist.

sections.label: Booking
sections.title: Book your eye test
sections.text: Send us a day and time on Telegram and we’ll confirm within an hour. The test is free if you order your glasses with us.

sections.label: Shop
sections.title: Frames and lenses
sections.text: Add to cart and check out — we will call to confirm and deliver.
